data.description:
## Summary

The mcp entrypoint skips cloning the tickets branch whenever `${REBAR_TRACKER_DIR}/.git` merely
EXISTS. A `.git` directory is not proof of a usable clone, and the named volume PERSISTS across
containers — so one interrupted clone poisons the store permanently. No later container
re-clones, and the server serves an empty tracker forever.

## Observed in production (2026-08-26)

The 120s blue-green health rollback removed containers mid-clone, repeatedly (that was bug
`unfit-beneficial-whimbrel`). Each removal left the volume holding orphaned objects. The
surviving state:

    du -sh $REBAR_TRACKER_DIR   ->  1.5G
    ls $REBAR_TRACKER_DIR       ->  0 ticket directories
    cat .git/HEAD               ->  ref: refs/heads/.invalid
    ls .git/refs/heads          ->  (empty)
    git rev-parse HEAD          ->  fatal: your current branch appears to be broken
    rebar list (in container)   ->  []

1.5 GB of objects, no worktree, no resolvable HEAD. Every subsequent container saw `.git`,
skipped the clone, and served `[]`.

## Why this is worse than a missing store

The absent-store guard (`antelopine-limivorous-chinchilla`) makes a MISSING store loud —
`store_uninitialized`. A poisoned store reads as PRESENT, so the guard correctly does not fire
and reads return `[]` again. The silent-empty failure mode is reintroduced through a different
door: a store that exists, is empty, and has no connection to origin.

## Fix

Require a RESOLVABLE HEAD before trusting the clone, and clear the directory before re-cloning
so partial objects cannot poison the retry:

    if ! git -C "$DIR" rev-parse --verify -q HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      rm -rf "$DIR"/.[!.]* "$DIR"/*
      git clone --single-branch --branch tickets "$URL" "$DIR" || echo "clone deferred" >&2
    fi

Verified against the exact production shape (`.git` present, HEAD -> refs/heads/.invalid, empty
refs/heads): the old guard SKIPS, the new one re-clones. A healthy store still resolves HEAD and
is skipped, so no needless re-clone of a ~200k-commit branch.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A tracker dir whose HEAD does not resolve is treated as unusable and re-cloned, not
      trusted because `.git` exists.
- [ ] The directory is cleared BEFORE the re-clone, so partial objects cannot survive into it.
- [ ] A healthy store (resolvable HEAD) is still skipped — no re-clone on every boot.
- [ ] Regression coverage pins the verify -> clear -> clone ORDER; clearing after the clone
      would delete the fresh store.

## Verification

    .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/unit/test_mcp_on_box_infra.py -q -p no:randomly

Teeth: reverting the guard to the `.git`-existence check turns
`test_mcp_entrypoint_reclones_an_unusable_store_rather_than_trusting_dot_git` RED.
data.title: mcp entrypoint trusts a bare .git, so one interrupted clone poisons the tickets volume permanently
